title: oenothera villosa subsp. strigosa
intro: Oenothera villosa subsp. strigosa, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a perennial herb native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including relief from menstrual cramps, menopausal symptoms, and skin conditions such as eczema and acne, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Evening Primrose include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve mood, and support heart health. The bioactive constituents of Oenothera villosa subsp. strigosa include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), a polyunsaturated fatty acid with potent anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
